snippet.title: Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems- Chao Games Showcase Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
I am happy to announce that Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems will have its first public demo available at Chao Games Showcase 2025! This demo includes:
-a tutorial zone (Training Tower), 
-the first four full zones (Miracle Mount, Shinobi Seaport, Pit Pot Parlor, and Dusty Desert),
- three playable characters (Alex, Stella, and Prince Egle)
- original Genesis remixes of music from the Alex Kidd series and other classic SEGA games
- a working map for zone selection
- story cutscenes!

While this trailer won't be included in the Chao direct (due to me not knowing about the showcase submissions even being open until after the trailer submission deadline...) I did want to pull one together anyway to help spread awareness. 

Once live, the CGS booth will be located here: https://hedgehogtechnicalinstitute.com/forum/viewtopic.php?t=196&sid=fb989ffab91fb930042472752fcc2c41
The .EXE download can be found here: https://ernestpkirby.itch.io/alex-kidd-and-the-miracle-gems

Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems is effectively an imagining of a Sonic-era Alex Kidd game that acts as a sequel to Alex Kidd in Miracle World, Alex Kidd in Shinobi World, and Alex Kidd and the Lost Stars. 

#chaogameshowcase #cgs2025 #cgs25 #alexkidd #alexkiddandthemiraclegems
